reviewProvenance.manualVisualComparison: Source is a colored green/yellow Electro in mid-action with yellow lightning, bent raised right leg on electrical urban equipment and a rocky base. The lone published candidate is a different monochrome sculpture standing upright with two cylindrical coils and a floating ball; not the same pose, geometry, base, or composition.
reviewProvenance.identityProofInterpretation: Human comparison of sculpt geometry, pose, outfit and base, corroborated by source/cover SHA-256 and dHash; perceptual hash and text matches alone never authorize merging.

mediaReview.notes: Creator/promotional branding appears in source and/or public images; no reuse, watermark editing, replacement or gallery import authorized.

decision.nextGate: Distinct sculpt proven; do not create a published catalog model or media until provenance, attribution and rights and deterministic identity are approved.
